nextStoryContext: transcriptPathForSession(uuid, cwd, claudeDir) is now the canonical path builder in src/transcript/usage.ts. orchestratorTranscriptPath is a thin wrapper that reads .cam-orch-session, calls transcriptPathForSession, and returns null on absent/empty. writeWorkerSessionMarker(claudeDir, storyId, uuid) writes .claude/.cam-worker-<storyId>.session; readWorkerSessionMarker(claudeDir, storyId) reads it back (null if absent/empty). US-006 can call writeWorkerSessionMarker after spawning the worker claude session; dashboard/status can call readWorkerSessionMarker + transcriptPathForSession to display per-story token usage.
